title: Patch a user record
hints: `Partial<User>` makes every field optional — including `id` and `updatedAt`, which a patch must not touch. Remove those keys first.
Combine two utility types: `Partial<Omit<User, ...>>`. Then build the new object with spread: `{ ...user, ...patch, updatedAt: now }` — later properties win.
type UserPatch = Partial<Omit<User, "id" | "updatedAt">>; — then, if `patch.email !== undefined`, overwrite `email` with `patch.email.trim().toLowerCase()`.
